prompt: This release changes how fees are rounded. If it is wrong it will not crash anything — invoices are produced, customers are charged, and reconciliation disagrees with the payment processor the next morning. Plan how this goes out and write the decision down. Keep the new fee calculation and the existing rollback.

assertions.description: The change reaches part of the traffic before all of it
Something is compared or checked during that stage
The full rollout depends on that stage rather than running regardless
The doc names the shape of the risk and the rollout choice it drove
The change being released was not reverted
The test job still gates what follows it
The service itself is left alone
